# A made-up Arch desktop with two people, alice and bob. Every name, ID and address is invented.
#
# Format: "-- path --" starts a file, whose contents run to the next header; "-- path [0440] --"
# sets its mode. "-- path -> target --" makes a symlink and "-- path/ --" an empty folder. Paths are
# relative to the fake root. Owners are set by the test: 1000 in /home/alice, 1001 in /home/bob,
# 970 in /var/lib/jellyfin, root elsewhere.

-- etc/passwd --
root:x:0:0::/root:/usr/bin/bash
bin:x:1:1::/:/usr/bin/nologin
jellyfin:x:970:970::/var/lib/jellyfin:/usr/bin/nologin
alice:x:1000:1000:Alice:/home/alice:/usr/bin/zsh
bob:x:1001:1001::/home/bob:/bin/bash
carol:x:1002:1002::/home/carol:/usr/bin/nologin
nobody:x:65534:65534:Nobody:/:/usr/bin/bash
-- etc/group --
root:x:0:root
wheel:x:998:alice
audio:x:995:alice,bob
jellyfin:x:970:
alice:x:1000:
bob:x:1001:

-- home/alice/.config/systemd/user/rclone-mount.service --

Description=Mount the cloud drive

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/rclone mount cloud: %h/Cloud --vfs-cache-mode=writes --log-file %h/.local/state/rclone/mount.log
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/notify-send "Cloud mounted"
ExecStop=/usr/bin/fusermount3 -u %h/Cloud
